panels.description: Junos release and family come from the JTSO metadata enrichment (no extra sensor needed).

targets.query: SELECT last("if_mtu") AS "x" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "device", "FAMILY", "VERSION"

panels.title: Device inventory

panels.description: NETCONF get-commit-information (latest commit, sequence 0). The commit_change.tick Kapacitor task raises an alert when it changes.

targets.query: SELECT last("commit_epoch") * 1000 AS "Last commit", last("commit_epoch") * 1000 AS "Age", last("commit_user") AS "User", last("commit_client") AS "Client" FROM "COMMIT" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "device"

panels.title: Latest commit

panels.description: cRPD: NETCONF get-system-memory-information (active/total, host memory). cSRX: SPU memory from 'show security monitoring'.

targets.query: SELECT last("mem_active_kb") / last("mem_total_kb") * 100 FROM "SYSTEM_MEMORY" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"
SELECT last("spu_mem_pct") FROM "SECURITY_SPU" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"

panels.title: Memory used

panels.description: NETCONF get-system-storage, mount point /. cRPD/cSRX run as containers: memory and disk values reflect the host they run on.

targets.query: SELECT last("storage_used_pct") FROM "SYSTEM_STORAGE" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"

panels.title: Disk used (/)

panels.description: NETCONF get-flow-session-information summary.

targets.query: SELECT last("flow_active_sessions") AS "Active", last("flow_failed_sessions") AS "Failed", last("flow_max_sessions") AS "Max" FROM "SECURITY_FLOW" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"

panels.title: Flow sessions (cSRX)

panels.description: cRPD: sum of cpu-utilization of long-running processes (gNMI /system/processes). Short-lived helpers (ifinfo, python3, ps, sh) are excluded because they report CPU relative to their own lifetime. cSRX: SPU CPU from 'show security monitoring' (data plane).

targets.query: SELECT sum("c") FROM (SELECT mean("process_cpu_utilization") AS "c" FROM "SYSTEM" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "process_name" !~ /^(ifinfo|python3|ps|sh)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "process_name") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME" fill(none)
SELECT mean("spu_cpu_pct") FROM "SECURITY_SPU" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME" fill(none)

panels.title: CPU total

panels.description: NETCONF get-system-memory-information. cRPD/cSRX run as containers: memory and disk values reflect the host they run on.

targets.query: SELECT mean("mem_active_kb") * 1024 AS "active", mean("mem_free_kb") * 1024 AS "free" FROM "SYSTEM_MEMORY" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME" fill(none)

panels.title: Memory

panels.description: NETCONF get-route-summary-information.

targets.query: SELECT last("rt_destinations") AS "Destinations", last("rt_total") AS "Total routes", last("rt_active") AS "Active", last("rt_hidden") AS "Hidden" FROM "ROUTE_SUMMARY" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "table_name"

panels.title: Routing tables (cRPD)

panels.description: NETCONF get-flow-session-information summary.

targets.query: SELECT mean("flow_active_sessions") AS "active", mean("flow_failed_sessions") AS "failed", mean("flow_active_drop_sessions") AS "drop" FROM "SECURITY_FLOW" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME" fill(none)

panels.title: Flow sessions over time (cSRX)

panels.description: NETCONF get-flow-statistics-all, converted to rates by the Telegraf rate processor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("flow_pkts_rx_rate") AS "rx", mean("flow_pkts_tx_rate") AS "tx", mean("flow_pkts_fwd_rate") AS "fwd", mean("flow_pkts_drop_rate") AS "drop" FROM "SECURITY_FLOW" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME" fill(none)

panels.title: Flow packets (cSRX)

targets.query: SELECT last("if_mtu") FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "if_name"
SELECT last("if_oper_status") FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)
SELECT last("if_admin_status") FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)

SELECT last("if_admin_status") AS "Admin", last("if_oper_status") AS "Oper", last("if_mtu") AS "MTU", last("if_type") AS "Type", last("if_index") AS "ifIndex" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "device", "if_name"

panels.description: Collected via gNMI /interfaces/interface/state/counters (cRPD). Rates computed by the Telegraf rate processor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("in_octets_rate")*8 AS "in", mean("out_octets_rate")*8 AS "out" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)

panels.title: Throughput

panels.description: Collected via gNMI /interfaces/interface/state/counters (cRPD). Rates computed by the Telegraf rate processor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("in_pkts_rate") AS "in", mean("out_pkts_rate") AS "out" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)

panels.title: Packets

panels.description: Collected via gNMI /interfaces/interface/state/counters (cRPD). Rates computed by the Telegraf rate processor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("in_errors_rate") AS "in_errors", mean("out_errors_rate") AS "out_errors", mean("in_drops_rate") AS "in_drops", mean("out_drops_rate") AS "out_drops" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)

panels.title: Errors & drops

panels.description: Collected via gNMI /interfaces/interface/state/counters (cRPD). Rates computed by the Telegraf rate processor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("mcast_in_pkts_rate") AS "mcast_in" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)

panels.title: Multicast in

panels.description: Interfaces configured up (admin) but not operationally up.

targets.query: SELECT last("if_admin_status") AS "Admin", last("if_oper_status") AS "Oper" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "if_name"

panels.title: Interfaces in drift

defaults.noValue: No drift: every admin-up interface is oper-up

targets.query: SELECT last("if_admin_status") AS "Admin", last("if_oper_status") AS "Oper", last("if_mtu") AS "MTU" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "device", "if_name"

panels.title: BGP peer-as: actual vs intent (bgp-peer-drift)
panels.description: Actual = openJTS gNMI NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP.session_peer_as; intent = naf_intent (usecase=bgp-peer-drift, seeded by observability/seed_intent.py). Rows are matched on the neighbour address. Kapacitor task bgp_peer_drift raises bgp-peer-drift:<device>:<neighbor>.

targets.query: SELECT last("session_peer_as") AS "Actual peer-as" FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "neighbor_address"
SELECT last("session_state") AS "State" FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND time > now() - 30d GROUP BY "neighbor_address"
SELECT last("peer_as") AS "Intended peer-as" FROM "naf_intent" WHERE "usecase" = 'bgp-peer-drift' GROUP BY "device", "neighbor_address"

panels.title: Orchestrator remediations
panels.description: Grafana annotations posted by the orchestrator on every 'remediated' event (GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS=true), tag naf.

panels.title: BGP session state (bgp-peer-drift)
panels.description: gNMI on_change session-state per device and neighbour.

targets.query: SELECT last("session_state") FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "neighbor_address" fill(previous)

panels.title: Received prefixes vs rx_max (prefix-limit)
panels.description: openJTS gNMI safi_received (post-policy, IPV4_UNICAST). Threshold lines: 40 = WARNING (80 % of rx_max), 50 = CRITICAL (intent rx_max). Kapacitor task prefix_limit.

targets.query: SELECT last("safi_received") FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "neighbor_afi_safi_name" = 'IPV4_UNICAST' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "neighbor_address" fill(previous)

panels.title: Prefix intent (prefix-limit)
panels.description: naf_intent usecase=prefix-limit (rx_min / rx_max per device and neighbour).

targets.query: SELECT last("rx_min") AS "rx_min", last("rx_max") AS "rx_max" FROM "naf_intent" WHERE "usecase" = 'prefix-limit' GROUP BY "device", "neighbor_address"

panels.title: csrx rule order: actual vs intent (security-policy-drift, deferred)
panels.description: Actual = naf_secpolicy (collector/netconf_poller.py --only secpolicy); intent = naf_intent usecase=security-policy-drift. Empty until the csrx has zones/policies (docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md Q1).

targets.query: SELECT last("rule_order") AS "Actual order", last("rule_count") AS "Actual rules" FROM "naf_secpolicy" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "device", "from_zone", "to_zone"
SELECT last("rule_order") AS "Intended order", last("rule_count") AS "Intended rules" FROM "naf_intent" WHERE "usecase" = 'security-policy-drift' GROUP BY "device", "from_zone", "to_zone"
